Ric Flair entered Georgia Tann’s adoption pipeline shortly after his birth in Memphis on February 25, 1949. Born Fred Phillips to Luther and Olive Phillips, he was adopted about a month later by Dr. Richard Reid Fliehr and Kathleen Fliehr, who raised him in Minnesota.

Flair’s biological mother was reportedly told that her baby had died or been abandoned, while falsified paperwork obscured what had happened. Some tampered records identified him as Fred Demaree or Fred Stewart.

In the 2022 Peacock documentary “Woooooo! Becoming Ric Flair,” he confirmed his original name: “Fred Phillips — I just found that out three years ago.” His 2004 autobiography, “To Be the Man,” includes a chapter titled “Black Market Baby.”

Georia Tann's operation targeted poor families and unmarried mothers. Children could be removed under the guise of medical care, while mothers were told their babies had died. Tann and her associates forged histories, altered or destroyed records and placed children with wealthy families outside Tennessee for substantial fees. She reportedly kept as much as 80% to 90% of the money in some cases.

The children considered most desirable, often blond, blue-eyed white infants, were sent to adoptive homes as far away as New York and California. Disease, malnutrition and neglect at the Memphis facility contributed to the deaths of hundreds of children.

Tann’s operation had protection from the political machine of Memphis boss E.H. “Boss” Crump. Shelby County Juvenile Court Judge Camille Kelley approved questionable removals that helped move children into Tann’s custody.

Tennessee Governor Gordon Browning launched an investigation around September 11 or 12, 1950. Tann died of uterine cancer on September 15 at age 59, days after the investigation began and before she could face charges. The Memphis branch closed soon afterward, and no one was criminally prosecuted.

A civil case against Tann’s estate recovered only a fraction of the fortune she had amassed, estimated at more than $1 million. Altered and destroyed records left parents searching for missing children and adoptees trying to recover their identities for decades.

🔔 Ethereum price breakout hinges on a close above $2,535 

➡️ Ethereum price hovered around $2,500 on Sep. 9 as buyers defended short-term support, but weakening momentum and negative capital flows kept a breakout above $2,535 out of reach. Ethereum price traded near $2,486 at the time of writing on Sep. 9 after briefly rising above $2,520 earlier in the session. Price remained almost unchanged on the daily chart as buyers and sellers competed around the psychological $2,500 level.

🔖 The narrow move followed several days of consolidation after ETH recovered from its early-September low near $2,430. Buyers have repeatedly stepped in around $2,478–$2,485, but each attempt to extend the recovery has met selling pressure between $2,525 and $2,535.Spot Ethereum exchange-traded fund outflows have reduced one source of institutional demand during the consolidation. Broader risk appetite has also remained weak ahead of the Federal Reserve’s Sep. 15–16 policy meeting, while higher energy prices linked to the U.S.-Iran conflict have added to inflation concerns.

⚠️ Regulatory uncertainty ahead of the expected U.S. Senate procedural vote on the Clarity Act on Sep. 15 has given institutional investors another reason to limit exposure. Ethereum has consequently struggled to separate from the wider risk-off tone across the crypto market.

Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance and Secure Firewall Threat Defense Software Logging Denial of Service Vulnerability
https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-asa-ftd-logging-dos-ZXXNesfN?vs_f=Cisco%20Security%20Advisory%26vs_cat=Security%20Intelligence%26vs_type=RSS%26vs_p=Cisco%20Secure%20Firewall%20Adaptive%20Security%20Appliance%20and%20Secure%20Firewall%20Threat%20Defense%20Software%20Logging%20Denial%20of%20Service%20Vulnerability%26vs_k=1

A vulnerability in the system rate-limiting process for syslog message 419002 of Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Cisco Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause high CPU utilization on an affected device, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.
This vulnerability is due to improper rate limiting for syslog message 419002. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a flood of TCP synchronization (SYN) packets to an affected device. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause high CPU utilization, resulting in performance degradation. 

Cisco has released software updates that address this vulnerability. There are workarounds that address this vulnerability.
This advisory is available at the following link:
https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-asa-ftd-logging-dos-ZXXNesfN
This advisory is part of a group of advisories. For a complete list of the advisories and links to them, see Cisco Advance Notification for Publication of September 16, 2026, Security Advisories (https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-notice-jfxK98ZP). On September 21, 1996, John F. Kennedy Jr. married Carolyn Bessette on Cumberland Island, Georgia. Guests were reportedly not invited until September 17. 

The ceremony took place in the First African Baptist Church, a tiny whitewashed chapel built in 1893, with only eight wooden pews and no electricity, so the vows were exchanged by candlelight around sunset. 

Carolyn wore a simple silk crepe gown by Narciso Rodriguez, who was then a little known designer, and she arrived late after the dress needed some last minute sewing. Nobody minded. His sister Caroline was matron of honor, and his cousin Anthony Radziwill was best man. His old friend Sasha Chermayeff, who had known him since their teenage years at Andover, was there too, and she has said she was sworn to secrecy and thought of the group as the old guard. Afterward, the couple honeymooned in Turkey and Greece.

📡 Interior Minister: Iran-Pakistan borders to operate around clock

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Emphasizing that relations between Iran and Pakistan are strategic and deep, Iranian Interior Minister Eskandar Momeni said that following bilateral agreements, the two countries' existing border crossings will operate around the clock, and a new crossing will be opened at Kuhak.

Momeni, has met with Pakistan’s Interior Minister Syed Mohsin Raza Naqvi in Tehran.
​
During Monday’s meeting, Momeni and Naqvi emphasized finalizing agreements to expand bilateral relations.
​
Naqvi invited Momeni to visit Pakistan.
​
Pakistan’s interior minister has made several trips to Tehran since Pakistan began its mediation efforts between Iran and the United States.
​
During his latest visit on August 10, he met President Masoud Pezeshkian, security chief Major General Mohsen Rezaei, Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, and Momeni.
